fields.headline: Accepts up to $255,000 from Alameda County for Safe Routes to School, October 2020 through September 2023
fields.summary: This amends the district's master contract with Alameda County's Health Care Services Agency by adding a new set of exhibits for the Active and Safe Oakland Safe Routes to School program. The County pays the district up to $255,000, invoiced quarterly, for October 1, 2020 through September 30, 2023. The attached cover sheet marks this as an original procurement contract, so the $255,000 is the full amount, not an increase. All other terms of the master contract stay the same.

20-2059.note: Corrected: the attached contract shows Alameda County pays the District up to $255,000 for this program, not the District paying the County. The amount is the contract's full total, not an increase.
20-2059.sourceIssue: The text says the amendment is "funding" the County program but does not say whether the $255,000 is paid by or to the District, or whether it is added money or the contract's total.
